Name: Cute Cribs
Author: orochifrogu
Description:
UPDATE 1.1.0: Added 9 new crib options in 3 different green colour palettes. Also, added an option in 'config' settings to 'enable' or 'disable' this mod, so that you can quickly and easily switch between different crib mods! (now 30 cribs total)

UPDATE: Optional Add-on file is NOW AVAILIBLE! Have you ever wanted to decorate your nursary with more than one crib? my optional file adds all 21 cribs into your furniture catalogue for you to decorate with as you please! <3 Thank you to alextofu for this wonderful suggestion 

₊✩‧₊˚౨ৎ˚₊✩‧₊ This mod adds 21 super cute cribs to your game! You can configure your choice within your mod configure menu (GMCM)! ₊✩‧₊˚౨ৎ˚₊✩‧₊

This is created to match my [size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34078]Cute Rugs[/url][/size] and [size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34250]Cute Beds[/url][/size] mods (both available for content patcher or alternative textures), so, I used the same 7 colour palettes and 3 wood grain types! 

[size=3]₊✩‧₊˚౨ৎ˚₊✩‧₊ I just released [url=https://youtu.be/mU9H2whIVm4]THIS youtube video[/url] showcasing all of my 'Cute' furniture so far!!! (cribs, beds, rugs) come check it out if you please!![/size][size=3]! ₊✩‧₊˚౨ৎ˚₊✩‧₊[/size]

I'm so happy with these adorable little cribs. I can't wait to create custom nursery furniture and decorations to match! <3 I think my favorite is still the 'dreamy' colourway, but... 'grape' and 'minty' are also really growing on me! idek they're all just so cute ⸜(｡˃ ᵕ ˂ )⸝♡

HOW TO INSTALL: 
1. ensure you have Content Patcher, SMAPI and Generic Mod Config Menu installed
2. download my file!!
3. unzip my file into your 'Mods' folder
4. Go into your GMCM menu and scroll through the list/select your option! Now your crib will be ⋆˙⟡CUTE⋆˙⟡

WHAT AM I WORKING ON NEXT:
1. Couches are coming next for this 'Cute' series!
2. Cute Nursery furniture!
3. small frog project <3 
4. More hairstyle mods for different NPCs... there are also quite a few that I'd like to make look more... attractive? cuter? 
ah and I have so many more things coming! These will be first though!!! ^
